iti41:1.1: 4 vuttaṃ hetaṃ bhagavatā vuttamarahatāti me sutaṃ
iti41:2.1: te bhikkhave sattā suparihīnā ye ariyāya paññāya parihīnā
iti41:2.2: te diṭṭhe ceva dhamme dukkhaṃ viharanti savighātaṃ saupāyāsaṃ sapariḷāhaṃ
iti41:2.4: te bhikkhave sattā aparihīnā ye ariyāya paññāya aparihīnā
iti41:2.5: te diṭṭhe ceva dhamme sukhaṃ viharanti avighātaṃ anupāyāsaṃ apariḷāhaṃ
iti41:6.1: ayampi attho vutto bhagavatā iti me sutanti.
